dataStatus: preview: events real, some locations SAMPLE/approx

events.title: Pony Club
events.summary: Cheer on Pony Club riders as they showcase their horsemanship and riding skills.

events.title: A Recipe for Life: The Food that Shapes Us
events.summary: A Recipe for Life: The Food that Shapes Us shares a unique history of food in Western Australia.

events.title: Affiliated Art Competition
events.summary: Discover a selection of winning artworks from agricultural shows across Western Australia, celebrating talented artists from communities around the State.

events.title: Agricultural Hall of Fame
events.summary: Discover the people who have helped shape Western Australian agriculture at the Agricultural Hall of Fame. Explore their stories, achievements and lasting contribution to the industry.

events.title: Ask me anything about Sheep
events.summary: Got a question about sheep? Ask the people who know them best!

events.title: Bee Discovery Hub
events.summary: Get busy with the bees! Taste local honey from Busy Bees, explore bee-friendly gardening with The Forever Project, find the Bee Tree and try hands-on activities that show kids how pollination helps our plants and food grow.

events.title: Blacksmiths
events.summary: Feel the heat and hear the hammer strike as the Blacksmiths Association of Western Australia (BAWA) brings one of the world’s oldest trades to life at the Show.

events.title: Capybara Treasure Hunt
events.summary: Get ready for the cutest quest of this year’s Perth Royal Show!

events.title: Cattle
events.summary: Some of WA’s finest cattle are coming to the Show. See impressive breeds up close, watch the judges choose their champions and discover what it takes to stand out from the herd.

events.title: Cattle Corner
events.summary: Curious about cattle? Stop by Cattle Corner to get a little closer to the animals, people and stories behind WA’s cattle industry.

events.title: Cavies Exhibition
events.summary: Discover the world of cavies and get a closer look at these much-loved small animals.

events.title: CBH Paddock to Port
events.summary: Ever wondered what happens to grain after it leaves the farm? Follow the journey from paddock to port with CBH Paddock to Port.

events.title: Channel 7 Activation
events.summary: Meet your favourite 7NEWS presenters, score some Channel 7 merch and find out what it feels like to step behind the news desk!

events.title: Community Dance and Cultural Performances
events.summary: Celebrate the rich diversity of Western Australia with vibrant dance and cultural performances from community groups, showcasing traditions, music and stories from around the world.

events.title: Conformation Dogs - General Specials
events.summary: The competition finale! See the top dogs from each breed group return to the ring as they compete for the coveted Best in Show title.

events.title: Cookery Exhibitions
events.summary: Admire beautifully crafted cakes, breads, preserves and baked treats as talented home cooks and bakers showcase their skills in this delicious display of creativity and tradition.

events.title: Country Women's Association (CWA)
events.summary: Say hello to the Country Women’s Association (CWA) and discover the people, skills and community behind this much-loved country organisation.

events.title: Creative Arts Exhibitions
events.summary: Celebrating a wide range of artistic and handcrafted talents, including knitting, crochet, quilting, embroidery, sewing, woodwork, and more.

events.title: Critters Up Close
events.summary: Meet some of the Farmyard Nursery’s wildest visitors! Get up close with snakes, lizards, spiders and a possum, and discover more about these fascinating creatures as you see them in person.

events.title: Dairy Land
events.summary: Head to Dairy Land to taste delicious samples from Perth Royal Food Awards winning producers.

events.title: Dog Conformation
events.summary: See familiar favourites, discover breeds you may never have met before and watch the competition build across Show week.

events.title: Dog Performance
events.summary: Fast paws, clever tricks and some seriously impressive teamwork. See talented dogs jump, weave, sniff, dance and show off their skills throughout Show week.

events.title: DPIRD Discoverer Trail
events.summary: Join the DPIRD Discoverer trail in the Farm 2 Food Pavilion.

events.title: Egg Decorating Competition
events.summary: Unleash your creativity in the Perth Royal Show Decorated Egg Competition, open to entrants of all ages.

events.title: Emporium
events.summary: Love a good shopping spree? Step inside The Emporium and see what catches your eye.

events.title: Farm 2 Food
events.summary: Ever wondered how your food gets from the farm to your plate? Follow the journey at Farm 2 Food and discover the people, produce and processes behind what we eat every day.

events.title: Farmyard Nursery
events.summary: One of the Show’s most-loved attractions is back with a fresh new look and even more animals to meet!

events.title: Farmyard Nursery Photography
events.summary: Strike a pose with some of the Farmyard Nursery residents and capture a special Show-day photo to take home!

events.title: Freshen Up Your Akubra
events.summary: Purchase a belt or wallet from R.M.Williams at the Show and enjoy complimentary Akubra steaming and reshaping, plus free leather embossing on your purchase.

events.title: Heritage Hall
events.summary: Step into WA’s farming past with an incredible collection of restored machinery, equipment and rural treasures.

events.title: Highland Cows
events.summary: Meet the Highland cows from Vizzari’s Highlands at Cattle Corner! Get up close with these shaggy favourites!

events.title: Horse Competitions
events.summary: Beautiful horses, talented riders and plenty of Main Arena action. Catch everything from Show Jumping to breed judging as horses take centre stage throughout Show week.

events.title: Livestock Collective VR
events.summary: Step into the world of livestock farming with a FREE virtual reality experience from Livestock Collective.

events.title: Masters Loaded Shakes
events.summary: Your favourite Masters flavours have gone all out for the Show. Choose from Chocolate, Strawberry, Spearmint or Mocha, topped with fresh cream, decadent sauces, and delicious loaded toppings for the ultimate Show treat.

events.title: Men's Shed
events.summary: Step inside and meet the makers at the Showgrounds Community Men's Shed!

events.title: Nova Supernovas
events.summary: Keep an eye out for the Supernova’s! They’ll be popping up around the Show every day with fun giveaways up for grabs.

events.title: Pat a Kelpie
events.summary: Meet one of Australia’s favourite working dogs! Get up close with a friendly Kelpie, give them a pat and learn more about the important role these clever, hardworking dogs play on farms.

events.title: Pat a Pig with Westpork
events.summary: Come and meet the pigs from Westpork! Get up close, give them a pat and enjoy the chance to meet these curious farm animals in the Farmyard Nursery.

events.title: PAWvilion
events.summary: PAWvillion is packed with four-legged fun, fascinating breeds and plenty of chances to see some seriously talented animals in action.

events.title: Performance Dogs - Tricks and Dancing with the Dogs
events.summary: Dogs that dance? You bet! Watch clever canines and their handlers show off tricks, musical routines and plenty of personality.

events.title: Photography Exhibition
events.summary: See incredible moments captured through the lenses of this year’s Perth Royal Show National Photographic Competition entrants.

events.title: Police Pavilion
events.summary: Meet WA Police, explore interactive displays and keep an eye out for their much-loved Constable Care mascot!

events.title: Police Pavilion
events.summary: Meet WA Police officers, explore the world of policing and keep an eye out for a special appearance from Constable Care!

events.title: Poultry
events.summary: While the traditional Poultry Competition won’t be going ahead this year, the Poultry Pavilion is still open with plenty to see and do.

events.title: Power-Up Paddock
events.summary: There’s a whole new way to explore agriculture at Farm 2 Food! Power-Up Paddock is packed with interactive challenges that put your skills to the test.

events.title: RAC Rescue Experience
events.summary: The RAC Rescue Experience (RRE) gives Western Australians an insight into the life-saving  role performed by the RAC Rescue helicopters and crew.

events.title: School Scarecrow Competition
events.summary: Get ready for some seriously adorable scarecrows! WA school students have been busy creating their own colourful characters, and now they’re coming to the Perth Royal Show.

events.title: Sensory Space
events.summary: Need a quieter moment during your Show day? The Sensory Space offers a calm, low-stimulation place to step away from the crowds and reset.

events.title: Shearing Demonstrations
events.summary: See speed, skill and plenty of action in the Sheep Shed, with shearing demonstrations and competition running across Show week.

events.title: Sheep
events.summary: From magnificent Merinos to leading meat breeds, see some of the best sheep in the country take their place in the Sheep Shed.

events.title: SISWA
events.summary: Enjoy a vibrant cultural performance celebrating the traditional music, dance and heritage of Sabah, bringing its stories and traditions to life on stage.

events.title: Smart Farms
events.summary: Farming is getting smarter. Step into Smart Farms to explore the technology, ideas and innovation changing the way we grow food and care for the land.

events.title: Spudette & Lady Carrotene Mascots
events.summary: Keep an eye out for Spudette and Carrotene as they make their way around the Show! These colourful characters are ready for waves, high-fives and plenty of photos.

events.title: Take Home a Free Lambie
events.summary: While you're visiting the Sensory Space, you can grab a free Perth Royal Show Lambie toy. Limited stocks available.

events.title: WA Farmers Drone Videos
events.summary: See Western Australian farming from a whole new angle with a video presentation featuring drone footage from across the State's agricultural landscapes.

events.title: Water Corporation
events.summary: Bring your WA game and play just enough putt putt!

events.title: Wool on Display
events.summary: Discover the remarkable journey of wool, from fleece to fibre, and explore the quality, versatility and craftsmanship behind one of Western Australia's most iconic agricultural products.

events.title: Yellow Brick Road
events.summary: This Show favourite is back, and this year it’s FREE for 10,000 families! Grab your bag, follow the trail and collect goodies as you make your way around the Showground.

events.title: Young Judges Competitions
events.summary: See the next generation of agricultural talent put their knowledge to the test across a packed program of Young Judges competitions.

events.title: With One Voice Perth
events.summary: With One Voice Perth brings its inclusive community choir to the Global Stage for an a cappella performance celebrating the simple joy of singing together.

events.title: Creative Arts and Cookery Demonstrations
events.summary: Watch talented makers and bakers bring their craft to life with live demonstrations showcasing creative techniques, decorating skills and time-honoured traditions.

events.title: Crop Creator Lab
events.summary: Get hands-on with real plant science at the Crop Creator Lab. Extract DNA from a strawberry and discover what’s happening beneath the surface of the crops we grow.

events.title: Milking Demonstrations
events.summary: Ever wondered where your milk really comes from? Meet the cows and see the journey from farm to fridge begin at the Milking Station.

events.title: Outback Encounters
events.summary: Get a taste of the outback with an encounter that brings a little country character to your Show day.

events.title: Sheep Dog Demonstrations
events.summary: See working dogs put their skills to the test in the Main Arena, as handler and dog work together to guide sheep through the course.

events.title: The WA Performance Troupe - Fire Troupe & Equinox Troupe
events.summary: Catch the Fire Troupe and Equinox Troupe joining forces for a high-energy dance showcase on the Global Stage.

events.title: Ag Bot Workshop
events.summary: Ever wanted to build the technology that helps crops grow? In the Ag Bot Workshop, kids get hands-on experience building and programming real agricultural sensors like light and soil monitors, unlocking the basics of coding for the modern farm.

events.title: Kids Kitchen
events.summary: Little cooks, aprons on! Get hands-on in the Kids Kitchen and discover more about the food we eat and where it comes from.

events.title: Pristine Piggy Parlour
events.summary: Time for a little piggy pampering! Head to the Pristine Piggy Parlour and watch the pigs get washed, scrubbed and ready to shine.

events.title: The Kitchen - Doughnut Duo - Sweet v Savoury
events.summary: Sweet or savoury? At The Kitchen presented by Linley Valley Pork and Amelia Park Lamb & Beef, Jo Gransby puts Brownes Dairy products to delicious use with two very different doughnut creations.

events.title: The Kitchen presented by Linley Valley Pork and Amelia Park Lamb & Beef
events.detail: From the Farm Kitchen hosted by Alex Crisp
events.summary: See farm-fresh produce put to delicious use as Alex Crisp brings 'From the Farm Kitchen' to The Long Paddock Stage.

events.title: Whip Cracking
events.summary: Ready to give it a crack? Learn the basics of whip cracking and have a go at this iconic country skill for yourself.

events.title: Woodchopping
events.summary: Axes ready! Some of the country’s best woodchoppers go head-to-head in a packed program of championship events at the Woodchop Arena.

events.title: Woodchopping Championship - Class 5 Final
events.summary: See the 275mm Standing Block Championship, where competitors race to chop through a vertical log in a classic test of speed, strength, accuracy and axe skills.

events.title: Drone Demonstration
events.summary: Look up! See drones take flight and discover how this high-flying technology is changing the way farmers work.

events.title: Governor's Cup
events.summary: One of the Perth Royal Show’s most prestigious agricultural honours, the Governor’s Cup recognises excellence and consistency across our livestock competitions.

events.title: Homestead Kitchen
events.summary: Something’s cooking at the Homestead Kitchen! Drop in for a quick, hands-on session made for little growers and curious minds.

events.title: Paw Patrol
events.summary: The pups are on a mission to the Perth Royal Show! Join Chase, Marshall and friends for a live PAW Patrol experience packed with music, fun and plenty of action for little Showgoers.

events.title: Empower Irish Dance
events.summary: Feel the rhythm of traditional Irish dance as Empower Irish Dance brings performers of varied ages and abilities together for a lively Global Stage showcase.

events.title: The Kitchen - Sticky Pork & Crunchy Apple Slaw
events.summary: Sweet, sticky and seriously satisfying! Alex Crisp turns Linley Valley pork scotch into a flavour-packed dish with fresh, crunchy apple slaw at The Kitchen presented by Linley Valley Pork and Amelia Park Lamb & Beef.

events.title: Centre Stage Dance & Entertainment
events.summary: From tiny dancers to young adults, Centre Stage Dance & Entertainment brings plenty of colour, movement and energy to the Show.

events.title: Paw Patrol Meet & Greet
events.summary: Calling all little PAW Patrol fans! PAW Patrol is coming to the Perth Royal Show for a special meet and greet.

events.title: Drone Workshops
events.summary: Get hands-on with drone technology and discover how drones are changing the way we farm.

events.title: Grand Parade
events.summary: See champion animals, exhibitors and handlers come together in the Main Arena for the Grand Parade

events.title: The Kitchen - The Spud Kings’ Loaded Potato Showdown with Tony Galati
events.summary: Tony Galati and Alex Crisp join forces to turn Spudshed potatoes into the ultimate loaded spud at The Kitchen presented by Linley Valley Pork and Amelia Park Lamb & Beef,

events.title: David "The Bullet" Smith Human Cannonball
events.summary: Yep, an actual human cannonball. Guinness World Record holder Dave “The Bullet” Smith is blasting into the Perth Royal Show for the first time ever, launching high across the Main Arena in a stunt you’ll have to see to believe.

events.title: DANELLA
events.summary: Catch DANELLA live with a soulful mix of blues, country and folk, brought together through original WA songwriting.

events.title: Live Butchering Demo with Vince Garreffa
events.summary: Join WA’s own “Prince of Flesh”, Vince Garreffa, for a live butchering demonstration on the Cattle Stage.

events.title: Sheep Dog Trials
events.summary: See working dogs put their skills to the test in the Main Arena, as handler and dog work together to guide sheep through the course.

events.title: Cobbie and Strawbelle Mascots
events.summary: Keep an eye out for Cobbie and Strawbelle!

events.title: Guess the Flavour: 5 Senses Challenge
events.summary: A guess the flavour challenge like no other! Will you play it safe and 'taste' the flavour or go all in and try another sense?

events.title: Lakeland Senior High School
events.summary: Lakeland Senior High School brings its specialist Music Technology program to the Global Stage, with student musicians presenting a contemporary live performance.

events.title: Matt & the Manbergs
events.summary: Turn back the clock with Matt & the Manbergs, a young Midland-based band inspired by the sounds of the 1960s, performing original songs, vocal harmonies and vintage-influenced arrangements.

events.title: Sprout Hour
events.summary: Dig into Sprout Hour, an agriculture-focused session exploring the world of farming, food and where it all comes from.

events.title: ZipLok
events.summary: Turn it up with ZipLok, a local all-girl pop-rock band bringing plenty of energy to the Global Stage.

events.title: Golden Hour Tunes, Battle of the Bands (Country Edition)
events.detail: Hosted by School of Rock Perth
events.summary: Turn up the country tunes as young musicians take to The Long Paddock Stage for a Battle of the Bands: Country Edition, hosted by School of Rock Perth.

events.title: The Copper Plains
events.summary: Turn up the volume with The Copper Plains, bringing original rock-pop to the Global Stage with a vintage edge.

events.title: Pony Club Fancy Dress
events.summary: Horses, ponies and riders dress to impress in the Pony Club Fancy Dress, with bright, imaginative costumes bringing plenty of colour and creativity to the competition.

events.title: The Royal Round up
events.summary: The Royal Round Up gets the evening action underway, kicking off the nightly Main Arena line-up at the Perth Royal Show.

events.title: Perth Royal Brass Band
events.summary: Hear the sound of live brass fill the Main Arena as Perth Royal Brass Band brings a bright, energetic performance to the evening program. Program details and timings may change, so check the latest schedule before your visit.

events.title: Hot Wheels Heroes Super Truck Show
events.summary: Get ready for big-truck action as the Hot Wheels Heroes Super Truck Show rolls into the Main Arena as part of the evening program.

events.title: Freestyle Motocross
events.summary: Freestyle Motocross hits the Main Arena with big air, huge tricks and gravity-defying stunts from Hardwired Entertainment.

events.title: Country Mash up
events.summary: Turn up the country atmosphere with Country Mash Up, bringing a lively burst of country-inspired entertainment to the Main Arena evening line-up.

events.title: Fireworks Spectacular
events.summary: The night sky comes alive at the Perth Royal Show with a spectacular fireworks display every night of the Show.
